title: chamaejasme stelleriana
intro: Chamaejasme stelleriana, commonly known as Steller's jessamine or Steller's passionflower, is a perennial plant species in the family Polemoniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Chamaejasme stelleriana include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
